subject: RStan freezing R application in Mac

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: RStan freezing R application in Mac
parts:
Hi,

I was wondering if anyone has seen this behavior. I verified that this happened on a colleague's installation.

The problem:
RStan 2.2.0 installs correctly.
The schools example runs fine in the R application.
The rats example does not. After RStan puts out a rejection message, the application freezes. Looking at activity monitor, it looks like RStan has stopped executing, but there's no ability to control the R application. The application itself responds to some clicking and page up and page down, but there's no way to get to the command prompt.
When running from the terminal, there is no problem.

Setup:
Mavericks
R 3.0.3
RGUI 1.63
RStan 2.2.0

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.0.3 (2014-03-06)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin10.8.0 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/C/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    

other attached packages:
[1] rstan_2.2.0   inline_0.3.13 Rcpp_0.11.1

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] stats4_3.0.3


This also appears with R 3.0.2 and GUI 1.62.



I've cc'ed Sid, who's the colleague with this issue. Could there be any package interaction that kills the R GUI when there's a message to the error stream?



Daniel

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] RStan freezing R application in Mac
parts:
Yes, I've seen this and thought it was just something
misconfigured with my R GUI.

I think it may be an issue with overwriting in the
output stream freezing the streams somehow. But maybe
it's an exception not being caught properly in a way
that the GUI messes up somehow?

- Bob
